meta.description: Order packaging online with getpack: see starting prices and production times straight away, design boxes at true size, and follow every step of production

hero.title:
Boxes your customers remember

designed by you, right here

priced as you go
hero.lead: We make boxes, bags and labels for small and growing brands. Enter a size, pick a board, place your logo, see the real box in 3D and order it — the price and delivery date follow every change, no waiting for a quotation.
hero.caption: Try the panel on the right — the price you see is the price you can order at.
hero.captionMobile: Try the panel below — the price you see is the price you can order at.

from the first line to your customer's hands

cases.title: Small brands that want to look big

capabilities.title:
What ordinary design software won't tell you

the studio will
capabilities.lead: The studio knows which board this file prints on, at what size, in which factory — so it warns you before it becomes a bad job

checks.title: Files checked while you design
checks.body: Resolution, safe zone, colours that cannot print — flagged as you place them, not days after you send the file
checks.lowRes: Logo at 72 dpi — it will break up at 4 cm. Use an SVG or 300 dpi or more
checks.fold: "30 ml" sits 2 mm from a fold — it may be cut. Move it inside the 3 mm safe zone
checks.colour: Pantone 3425 C on kraft — we match it as closely as the board allows; see the real colour on your sample proof

cost.title: See the cost before you decide
cost.body: Every option shows what it adds, quantities side by side — no new quotation each time you change your mind
cost.foil: Add gold foil to the logo

team.title: Show your team before you order
team.body: Share a link to comment on the 3D box, keep every version, go back to any, and order the version everyone agreed on
team.ownerSays: Could the logo move up a little? It looks close to the edge
team.designerSays: Moved — version 3, have a look at the front

quality.title:
We don't have one factory

but we run quality like one
quality.body: Each kind of job goes to the factory in our audited network that does it best. Our people check and photograph every lot before it is closed — and the studio is a choice, not a requirement: have a file already or ordering again, use these two

upload.title: Upload a print file
upload.body: PDF/AI — resolution and safe zone checked for you

business.title: Business accounts
business.body: Easy reorders · several approvers · credit terms
